paragraph.text: Tämä artikkeli on kirjoitettu vain nykyisenä versiona, eikä sillä ole muokkaushistoriaa ollenkaan.

sql.label: The article
sql.statement: SELECT lang, page_id, rev_id, wikidata_id, title, date_modified FROM article WHERE lang = ? AND page_id = ?

sql.label: Same topic in other languages
sql.statement: SELECT wikidata_id, lang, page_id, title FROM article WHERE wikidata_id IN (?) ORDER BY lang, page_id

sql.label: Has history
sql.statement: SELECT rev_id, user, row_start AS saved_at FROM article_history WHERE page_id = ?

sql.label: Reading order and paragraphs
sql.statement: SELECT o.pos, o.heading, o.para_id, p.kind, p.section, p.text, p.citations, s.badge, s.badge_label, s.badge_reasons FROM article_outline o LEFT JOIN paragraph p ON p.lang = o.lang AND p.page_id = o.page_id AND p.para_id = o.para_id LEFT JOIN paragraph_signal s ON s.lang = o.lang AND s.page_id = o.page_id AND s.para_id = o.para_id WHERE o.lang = ? AND o.page_id = ? ORDER BY o.pos
